periods.min_c: Minimum in the 24 hours to 09:00 AEST on the labelled date.
periods.max_c: Maximum in the 24 hours from 09:00 AEST on the labelled date.
periods.rain_to_9am_mm: Rain in the 24 hours to 09:00 AEST on the labelled date; not calendar-day rainfall.
periods.wind_kph: Higher of the available 09:00 and 15:00 ten-minute-average wind readings; not an all-day maximum.
periods.gust_kph: Strongest wind gust in the 24 hours to midnight AEST on the labelled date.
periods.sky: Only explicitly reported sky conditions are classified. Unreported cloud/rain/sun remains unknown.
